_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's request and response examples for the PIM for Azure resources REST API (Microsoft.Authorization 2020-10-01), the examples the Learn REST reference pages render. Learn's own how-to pages for the same API (Use Azure PIM to manage eligible access with the REST API, and its policy and active-access companions) aren't published in a public MicrosoftDocs repository, so their source can't be pinned; these examples are the closest public Microsoft source. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Microsoft REST examples: PIM for Azure resources (role eligibility and assignment schedule requests, role management policies), API version 2020-10-01
files_last_changed: 2026-02-12 (commit 7c98c2cc77b5186209f42cf9c8260e367c892d28, a move to the unified folder structure); LICENSE 2017-02-06 (commit 2940a1cbc6ef193d8e82372fdcb6e8792136fa0f)
license: MIT (LICENSE, copied from the repository root).
not_copied: The other 32 examples in the same folder (get by name, instances, cancel, validate, policy assignments, eligible child resources, delete, the full policy PATCH): Chapter 06 makes only the list, PUT and partial PATCH calls these six examples show.
The OpenAPI files themselves (RoleEligibilityScheduleRequest.json and the rest) and every other API version: the chapter cites the Learn REST reference pages rendered from them.
